blocks.content: Quiz: What does the justify-content property control?
Tap an option below to answer:
How flex items are aligned along the main axis of a flexbox.
The justify-content property aligns flex items along the main axis of their container.
The justify-content property aligns flex items along the main axis of their container.
How elements are distributed within the document structure.
The justify-content property works within a flexbox context, not the whole document structure.
The justify-content property works within a flexbox context, not the whole document structure.
The color and style of the border around an element.
The justify-content property doesn't manipulate the border style; it manages the alignment of flex items within a container instead.

The font size and style of text within an element.
The justify-content property isn't meant to alter text style. It manages the alignment of flex items within a flexbox.
